name: Receptionist
source: After acknowledging the protagonist's pure heart, she deems him qualified to enter the Dream Club. Always waiting by the entrance, she serves as a guide of sorts, her tone and poise always impeccably polite and formal. Her name remains a mystery, only being referred to by her position in the establishment.
